Text.value: WASD walk   Space jump   wade into the lake

systems.name: walk_input
systems.doc: Keys into the character controller: A/D and W/S set the walking speed (6 m/s), Space asks for a jump (6.5 m/s up) when on the ground.

systems.name: wade
systems.doc: The engine puts InWater on a character whose feet are under the water and takes it off when it climbs out: only those are visited here. The deeper the water, the slower the walk (down to 30% at 1.5 m).

systems.name: dry
systems.doc: The resource hero.wet is 1 while the hero is in the water (written by `wade`) and 0 otherwise.
